map.由声强求声强级（I₀=10⁻¹² W/m²） 使用指南: Sound Intensity Level from Intensity (I0 = 10^-12 W/m2) User Guide
map.输入声强值，以参考声强 I₀=10⁻¹² W/m² 按 10·log₁₀(I/I: Enter a sound intensity value and compute the sound intensity level (dB) as 10*log10(I/I0) against the reference intensity I0 = 10^-12 W/m2; used for noise level rating and hearing protection assessment.
map.输入声强，求声强级。: Enter the sound intensity to get the sound intensity level.
map.由声强 I 求声强级 L_I=10·log10(I/I0)，I0=10⁻¹² W: Sound intensity level from intensity I: L_I = 10*log10(I/I0), where I0 = 10^-12 W/m2.
map.把实测声强换算成对数刻度做噪声评价。: Convert measured sound intensity to a logarithmic scale for noise assessment.
map.与声压级互为校验（自由场中两者相等）。: Cross-checks with the sound pressure level (the two are equal in a free field).
map.：某处声强 I=10⁻⁶ W/m²，I0=10⁻¹² W/m²，L_I=10·l: : At a location with sound intensity I = 10^-6 W/m2 and I0 = 10^-12 W/m2, L_I = 10*log10(10^6) = 60 dB.
map.单层均质墙的场隔声量: Sound insulation of a single-layer homogeneous wall
map.一端闭口管基频（f₁ = v / 4L）: Fundamental of a pipe closed at one end (f1 = v / 4L)
map.两端开口管基频（f₁ = v / 2L）: Fundamental of a pipe open at both ends (f1 = v / 2L)
map.声强级和声压级有什么区别？: What is the difference between sound intensity level and sound pressure level?
map.声强级由声强定义，声压级由声压定义；自由场且平面波时二者数值相等。: Sound intensity level is defined from intensity and sound pressure level from pressure; in a free field with plane waves the two are numerically equal.
map.这是人耳在 1 kHz 附近可听阈的近似声强，被定为声强级基准。: This is the approximate intensity of the human hearing threshold near 1 kHz, set as the reference for sound intensity level.
